verdict.rationale: The evidence shows online code review on GitHub. Copilot can review code and attach suggested changes that you apply in a couple of clicks (github-docs-25), initial reviews can be assigned to Copilot (github-docs-9), and you can review diffs and open pull requests (github-docs-26). It never documents human reviewers leaving inline comments or developers replying to and resolving inline comment threads. Missing for 10: documentation of inline review comment threads and replies, a human-to-human pull request review workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
